rules.source: Library first. If a place-specific motif is missing after searching names, aliases and location, create one in the established punk/Xerox and nodes-and-wire style, research recognizable details, and register it with a stable ID and Design API record before website use. This standing creation exception needs no additional permission request. No unrelated replacements, scraped substitutes or runtime-generated fallbacks.
rules.background: Every card design includes a registered nodes/network background and its mapped category companion behind content.
rules.libraryMotion: Static still examples with motion instructions only.
rules.orientation: All three network layers share one orientation. Consecutive cards alternate; internal layers never flip independently.

motion.glitch: One decorative plane only, stable unsynchronized distortion intervals.

rules.placement: Keep current card geometry, controls, logos, typography, margins, photos and decorative anchors. Hero cropped 40–70% visible; companion stays behind content.
rules.color: Use current card tokens, pure white and black. Hoüz house uses border cyan. Flags keep 20% original stripe color and exact shape.
rules.photos: Keep required photo validation, full-bleed/inset layering, and multi-photo slideshow. No photos on Mizzed.
rules.portraits: Profile photo first, optional additional faces/open slots; independent tiny floating and 8% hover scaling. Portrait behavior is separate from networks.
rules.missing: Unknown categories receive the registered network only; report missing companion instead of inventing one.

gaps.note: The existing paper house is selected. A separate approved punk FOR RENT sign was not found in the catalog or production assets; no substitute or new artwork was invented.
